
## Improvements

- Added Fire TV-specific launcher artwork using the rectangular Saab TV banner. Android launchers retain the adaptive icon. Fire OS controls the final tile layout and may cache old artwork.
- Moved password Show/Hide buttons into separate, remote-focusable controls on login and signup.
- Added QR-based phone login and signup over temporary local HTTPS, with explicit confirmation on the TV. Phone and TV must be on the same private network. Verify the temporary certificate's SHA-256 fingerprint against the TV before trusting it; if your browser cannot display the fingerprint, use the TV form instead. The pairing server expires after five minutes and closes on cancellation or leaving the screen.
- Added legacy certificate-reading and cryptographically verified JAR-signature fallbacks for update verification. Signature checks remain strict and pinned to the existing Saab TV release certificate.

## Installation

If the 0.1.57-beta updater rejects the official APK, manually sideload this release once **without uninstalling**. The old updater cannot apply its own fix before installation. If Android's installer itself reports a signing-key conflict, stop and investigate rather than deleting local data.

## Verification

155 local JVM tests passed, including verification of the published APK's JAR signatures. Release lint has no errors. The APK uses the existing release signing key. Fire Stick launcher appearance, remote controls and phone pairing still require hardware validation; device instrumentation tests were compiled but not run.
